candidate.title: npm CLI output preflight can race with symlink replacement
candidate.evidence: Baseline reports ensureWritable uses fs.existsSync before later fs.writeFileSync(file,data), without atomic no-clobber or symlink defense.
candidate.counterevidence: Requires attacker write access to chosen output directory; native publication uses a separate hardened path. Reportability and exact wrappers not yet parent-validated.

additionalEvidence.explanation: Baseline additionally found predictable temporary pathname opened for truncating write without exclusive/no-follow flags; attacker with write access to plan directory can preplant a symlink.
